aboutGame.title: What is Disney Lorcana Hyperia City?
paragraphs: Disney Lorcana Hyperia City is a trading card game expansion from Ravensburger that moves Disney Lorcana into a neon-lit metropolis. The set brings together Disney and Pixar characters, with a strong focus on Pixar's Coco, and introduces music-driven card designs, songs, discard-pile payoffs, and the Ink Drop mechanic.

Players build 60-card decks using up to two ink types, then quest for lore, challenge opposing characters, and race to 20 lore. Hyperia City supports sealed play at prerelease events and constructed deck building, giving newcomers a complete set to learn with and experienced players fresh archetypes to test.

modules.name: Disney Lorcana Hyperia City Ink Drops Guide
modules.description: Learn how Hyperia City's Ink Drop tokens generate temporary Ink, when to spend or save them, and how they change turn planning across all six ink colors.

highlights.detail: Collect Ink Drop tokens from Hyperia City card effects; each token can be held across turns.
Spend one token to add 1 Ink for the current turn without permanently growing your inkwell.
Save tokens when the extra Ink unlocks a key cost or lets you play two cards together.
Pair Ink Drops with card draw so the burst turn has enough cards to use the extra Ink.

modules.name: Disney Lorcana Hyperia City Beginner Guide
modules.description: Learn the fundamentals of Disney Lorcana with Hyperia City: how to play cards, manage ink, quest for lore, challenge characters, and build a first deck.

highlights.detail: Build a deck with at least 60 cards, no more than two ink types, and up to four copies of a card with the same full name.
Add one card to your inkwell each turn, then play characters, actions, items, and locations.
Quest with dry characters to gain lore; the first player to reach 20 lore wins.
Challenge exerted opposing characters by comparing Strength and Willpower.
Practice with a starter deck or sealed pool before upgrading to singles and a tuned list.

modules.name: Disney Lorcana Hyperia City Deck Building Guide
modules.description: Turn the Hyperia City card pool into a focused deck with clear ink pairings, curve targets, core cards, and a repeatable testing routine.

highlights.label: Ink Pair
highlights.detail: Commit to two ink types so every card in the deck can support the same plan.

highlights.label: Curve
highlights.detail: Target enough one- and two-cost plays to spend Ink consistently from the first turns.

highlights.label: Core
highlights.detail: Lock 12 to 16 engine cards before filling the remaining slots with role players.

highlights.label: Testing
highlights.detail: Play ten games, log missed ink drops, then cut the six weakest cards.

highlights.label: Uninkable
highlights.detail: Keep uninkable cards near 8 to 12 so a full hand rarely stalls your inkwell.

items.question: What is Disney Lorcana Hyperia City?
items.answer: Disney Lorcana Hyperia City is a trading card game expansion from Ravensburger that brings Disney and Pixar characters into a modern metropolis. It introduces the Ink Drop mechanic, expands the song and discard themes, and includes characters from Pixar's Coco.

items.question: When does Disney Lorcana Hyperia City release?
items.answer: Disney Lorcana Hyperia City prerelease events begin October 16, 2026, and the full retail launch follows on October 23, 2026.

items.question: How do Ink Drops work in Disney Lorcana Hyperia City?
items.answer: Ink Drop tokens in Disney Lorcana Hyperia City are one-time resources. Spending a token adds 1 Ink for the current turn, so you can reach a key cost earlier or fit an extra card into a turn.

items.question: How many cards are in a Disney Lorcana Hyperia City deck?
items.answer: A Disney Lorcana Hyperia City deck follows the standard Lorcana deck rules: at least 60 cards, no more than two ink types, and no more than four copies of a card with the same full name.

items.question: Which inks support the Disney Lorcana Hyperia City Ink Drop mechanic?
items.answer: All six inks have access to Ink Drops in Disney Lorcana Hyperia City, with Amethyst, Emerald, and Sapphire offering the deepest generation and synergy.

items.question: Where should a new player start with Disney Lorcana Hyperia City?
items.answer: Start with the Disney Lorcana Hyperia City beginner guide, learn the 20-lore win condition, and practice with a starter deck or sealed pool before buying singles for a tuned deck.
